text:
olivia_csm: Mariner Health says the sales-issued credit from their contract didn't land. They attached the PO and a PO memo — customer is asking for an immediate apply.

sales_ben: OK. can you paste the exact memo they sent?

olivia_csm: here it is — copied from the attachment: ```PO: PO-9453
Memo: Apply contract promo Q3-ENT-50 — credit 50,000 USD; billing contact: acct@mariner.co
Note: 'Apply to pro-rate'```

acct_ops_tom: thanks. looks like our PO parser dropped the memo during ingestion. i see a parsing exception in the billing logs: `ParseError: unexpected token U+2014 at offset 18` (em dash).

eng_platform_lee: can you link the log line and ticket? we can make the parser more tolerant but need to triage impact.

acct_ops_tom: filed ticket #4562. repro steps: `curl -X POST https://billing.internal/v1/po -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '@po.json'` where po.json contains the memo above. parser returns 400 + ParseError. logs: <https://logs.redwood-internal/trace/4562|logs>.

billing_bot: AUTO: created billing adjustment draft for Mariner Health (adj-2026-03-16-78), awaiting manual approval.

olivia_csm: customer has a renewal kickoff next Tue. sales asked if we can manually apply the full promo credit now so it doesn't block the conversation.

finance_arya: for a manual grant we need the sales approval chain (screenshot/email), signed contract, and the final invoice to post the adjustment. also confirm GL code + effective date.

sales_ben: I approve. attaching signed contract scan in thread. GL code: 4002. effective date: 2026-03-15.

acct_ops_tom: i'll run the manual credit now once docs are attached. command i'm going to run (internal): ```./billing_tool grant-credit --cust mariner-health --amount 50000 --code 4002 --note 'Q3-ENT-50 PO-9453 manual'```

olivia_csm: please CC me on the confirmation so i can update the customer.

acct_ops_tom: done — adjustment adj-2026-03-16-78 applied, invoice updated, and ledger posted. tagging @finance_arya for audit. :white_check_mark:

finance_arya: received. i'll upload approval screenshots + contract + audit record to the shared folder: <https://drive.redwood/shared/Mariner/adj-2026-03-16-78|drive>.

eng_platform_lee: created a follow-up PR to make the PO parser tolerate U+2014/em-dash and smart-trim other unicode punctuation. aiming for canary this week. PR: <https://git.redwood/internal/pr/789|PR-789>.

olivia_csm: great work, thanks everyone. i'll confirm with Mariner once docs are posted and close the loop.
